journal_lines: Wedged in a root: a circlet of bone and river-iron. Old and deliberate. Brought it home.
Something made, not natural. Bone worked into a circle. Very old. Brought it anyway.
Found it half-buried at the base of an old tree. Bone and wire, shaped with intention.
Ring of bone and worked metal. Not decorative. Something older than decorative.
Found it on a ledge that something had clearly been using. Not recently. Brought it anyway.
Made deliberately, with intention. The materials are strange. The craftsmanship is older.
Small enough to hold in a paw. Heavy enough to notice.
The bone is too uniform to be accidental. Something shaped it.
A crown that belonged to something. Decided it belonged with me now.
Placed exactly in the center of a stone ring. Left everything else. Took this.
Age on it. The kind that accumulates in the earth over time no one alive remembers.
Found on the body of something that didn't need it anymore. Careful retrieval.
